items.exampleEn: The river is shallow enough to walk across.
items.exampleZh: 這條河很淺，可以走過去。

items.exampleEn: The dancers gave a spectacular show.
items.exampleZh: 舞者們帶來一場精彩壯觀的表演。

items.exampleEn: A judge in a contest should be neutral.
items.exampleZh: 比賽的評審應該保持中立。

items.exampleEn: The house sits among rolling green fields.
items.exampleZh: 那棟房子坐落在起伏的綠色田野間。

items.exampleEn: Water and milk are both liquids.
Don't be nasty to your little brother.
items.glossZh: 惡劣的；令人討厭的；難聞的

items.exampleEn: Draw a red dot on the map.
The artist made a giant sphere out of glass.
items.exampleZh: 那位藝術家用玻璃做了一個巨大的球體。

items.sentenceEn: This dress has small white dots.
items.sentenceZh: 這件洋裝有白色的小圓點。

items.audioEn: Don't swim here. The water looks deep, but it is very shallow, and there are rocks.
items.audioZh: 不要在這裡游泳。水看起來很深，其實很淺，而且有石頭。
items.questionZh: 為什麼不要在這裡游泳？
options: The water is too cold today
There are too many fish here

items.sentenceEn: The fireworks were spectacular this year.
Pour the liquid into a glass.

items.stemEn: The children played in the ____ end of the pool.
items.stemZh: 孩子們在泳池的淺水區玩。

items.passageEn: On our school trip to the science museum, we first watched a spectacular film about space. It showed the earth as a blue sphere, and from far away, our city looked like a tiny dot. The film highlighted how small we are. Next, we learned that most of the earth is covered by liquid water, but some seas are quite shallow. Then we rode home through rolling hills. Sadly, the bus smelled nasty because someone had left old food in it. On the bus, two of my friends argued about which planet was the most interesting, and I tried to stay neutral.
items.passageZh: 學校校外教學去科學博物館時，我們先看了一部關於太空的壯觀影片。片中把地球呈現為一顆藍色的球體，從遠處看，我們的城市就像一個小點。影片突顯出我們是多麼渺小。接著，我們學到地球大部分被液態的水覆蓋，但有些海其實很淺。之後我們搭車穿過起伏的丘陵回家。可惜車上有股難聞的味道，因為有人把吃剩的食物留在車上。在車上，我的兩個朋友爭論哪一顆行星最有趣，我試著保持中立。

questions.questionZh: 朋友們在車上爭論什麼？
options: 博物館的門票是不是太貴了
誰應該坐在靠窗的位子

items.promptZh: 這座城市的夜景很壯觀。
referenceEn: The night view of this city is spectacular.
This city has a spectacular night view.
rubricZh: spectacular 表示「壯觀的、驚人的」，例如 a spectacular view 等說法
時態配合內容（例如現在簡單式等）

items.promptZh: 這部電影的故事很膚淺。
referenceEn: The story of this movie is very shallow.
This movie has a very shallow story.
rubricZh: 用 shallow 表示「膚淺的」
